title: Picture Viewer
items: New setting in Settings → Chat Behavior → Open Images: enlarge pictures inside ElderKeep like before, or open them in their own pop-out window you can move, resize or put on another monitor.
The pop-out window remembers where you left it — once you move or resize it, every picture after that opens in the same size and spot.
Pictures now have zoom (buttons, mouse wheel, or click to zoom where you clicked) and a fullscreen button. Drag to look around a zoomed picture; Esc closes.
Copy Image: a copy button on the picture viewer, Ctrl+C while a picture is open, and Copy Image in a picture message's right-click menu. Copies the full-size picture.
The enlarged picture no longer slides under the title bar at the top of the window.

title: Audio Recovery
items: If the speakers you picked in Settings get unplugged, voice now falls back to your system default instead of going silent. Your saved choice is kept, and comes back when the device does.
Settings → Voice now tells you when a saved microphone or speakers aren't connected, instead of showing "System Default" while quietly still using the missing one.

title: Hands Off
items: Your keyboard's play/pause keys no longer control videos in ElderKeep — they go to Spotify or whatever else you're listening to, instead of both at once.
Screen sharing a heavy game no longer shrinks to a tiny, blurry picture: Auto FPS Guard now only lowers the resolution when that actually helps, and undoes it when it doesn't.
Shares at certain sizes no longer drop to a slower encoder that used extra CPU.
Tip: for demanding games, share Entire Screen at 30 FPS — it keeps a sharp picture far better than sharing the game window.

title: Clear Signal
items: Noise suppression finally works — it was quietly switched off for everyone. Fans, hiss and keyboard noise are now filtered out of your mic.
If your connection drops or the server restarts, you come back still muted and deafened — your mic is never turned back on by itself.
Muting while holding push-to-talk now cuts your mic straight away.
Double-clicking a voice channel no longer leaves your microphone in use after you leave voice.
Switching mics mid-call no longer leaves extra audio processing running, and Mic Monitor keeps working afterwards.
Switching voice channels while sharing your screen now ends the share instead of leaving it running where nobody can see it.
Watch more than one screen share at once — each opens in its own window, and leaving voice closes them.
Your screen-share panel now shows what each viewer actually gets — frame rate, speed and packet loss — in green, amber or red.
Removing a viewer from your screen share always works now, and two people sharing with each other connect reliably.

title: Watch It Here
items: YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch and Streamable links now show a real player right under the message — press play and it plays in ElderKeep, no second window.
The player appears on its own as soon as a link is posted. Use the ✕ next to the link to collapse one, or turn the whole thing off in Settings → Behavior.
Clicking through to the site from inside a player now opens your normal browser instead of a bare window.

title: Portrait Diagnostics
items: The server now records portrait changes in its log, so if a new picture doesn't appear for everyone straight away we can see exactly where it stopped.

title: Instant Portraits
items: Change your profile portrait and everyone sees it straight away — no more waiting for them to rejoin the channel before the new one shows up.
The carved frames around player rows are now optional: Settings → Appearance → Panel Widths → User Row Frames.
Those frames are OFF by default now. If you liked them from the last update, switch them back on there.

title: Framed
items: Player rows in the Channel, Friends, Clan and Voice lists now sit in their own carved frame, the way Warcraft III shows them.
Profile icons in those lists are much bigger — you can actually tell who is who at a glance now.
Hovering a player no longer washes the row's frame out.

title: New Faces
items: 80 new profile icons — dragons, beasts, heroes, demons, elementals and a few jokes. All newly drawn at four times the old resolution.
Profile icons render sharp now instead of blocky, everywhere they appear.
Voice: switching between your headset and your speakers mid-session now just works. ElderKeep picks the change up and moves your microphone across instead of staying silent on the old device.
Voice: if the microphone or speakers you picked in Settings have been unplugged, ElderKeep now tells you and falls back, instead of quietly using the wrong one.
Reactions: the hover toolbar no longer stays stuck on a message after you add a reaction through the ⋯ menu.
Reactions: an emoji picked for your chat box after closing the reaction picker is no longer sent as a reaction to an old message by mistake.
Arcade: Arkanoid, Pac-Keep, Snake and Tetris rebuilt to match the real mechanics of the originals.
Pac-Keep: eaten pellets no longer box you in, and the games scale properly to the window.
Arcade: plays unranked instead of hanging when the server has no arcade.
Warcraft III LAN games now say plainly that Reforged 3.0.0 removed LAN, instead of looking broken.

title: The Arcade
items: New ElderKeep Arcade in Play Games — four games built right into ElderKeep: Arkanoid, Pac-Keep, Snake and Tetris.
Every game keeps a global top-100 and your own personal best, so you can see exactly where you stand.
Earn badges by beating score milestones. They sit on your profile and nobody can take them off you.
Whoever holds first place on a board wears its crown — and loses it the moment somebody beats them.
Chess against other players, properly rated. Queue for a game, or right-click anyone and pick Challenge to Chess.
Every chess move is checked by the server, so a bad client can't cheat the board. Drop offline mid-game and you have a minute to get back before it's a forfeit.
Runs still play when you're offline — they just don't count towards the leaderboards.

title: Text Notes
items: New /txt command: post a long piece of text as a single clickable card instead of a wall of messages. Click it to read the whole thing in its own window, with a Copy button.
Pasting a long block of text into the chat box now offers to post it as a note, instead of silently cutting it off at the message limit.
Notes hold up to 20,000 characters. The first line becomes the title, and the channel only ever shows one line no matter how long the note is.
Notes behave like any other message — they stay in the channel's history and can be reacted to.
Message length is back to 512 characters. The brief jump to 2000 in the last release made ordinary chat messy, and long text now has a home of its own.

title: Send Files, Say More
items: You can now send a file to someone — drag it onto their name in the user or friends list, or right-click them and pick Send File.
Files travel straight from your computer to theirs. They never pass through the ElderKeep server and are never stored on it, so nothing you send sits on someone else’s machine waiting to be found.
Every transfer has to be accepted by the person receiving it. The new FILE button next to GIF opens Transfers, where you can watch progress and cancel at any time.
Received files are checked against the sender’s fingerprint before they are saved — if anything doesn’t match, the file is deleted instead of kept.
If someone sends you a program — an .exe, .msi, .bat and the like — you get a separate warning that names what it really is, including the “invoice.pdf.exe” trick. That warning can’t be switched off.
Files are saved to Downloads\ElderKeep and marked as downloaded, so Windows still checks them if you open one. ElderKeep never opens a received file for you.
Settings → File Transfer: choose who may send you files (friends only to start with), the largest file you’ll accept, and where they are saved.

Because files go directly between the two of you, both need to be online and able to reach each other. On mobile data, a carrier connection or a locked-down work network, a direct link sometimes can’t be made — ElderKeep tells you that plainly instead of stalling. Type /ftprobe followed by a name to test a connection without sending anything.
Phones and the web version can send files but not receive them yet.
Fixed: in voice you could mute someone but not un-mute them — un-muting only re-enabled their button without turning their microphone back on, so to everyone else they stayed muted.
Messages can now be up to 2000 characters, instead of 512 — room to actually explain something without splitting it across four messages.

A very long message folds down to about six lines with a “Show more” toggle, so one wall of text can’t bury the conversation. Nothing is trimmed — expand it and the whole thing is there, and it stays searchable and copyable either way.
Turn the folding off in Settings → Behavior → Collapse Long Messages.

title: Join Your Friend's Game
items: Friend game announcements now say who joined — “Your friend Mark just joined …”.
Every announcement carries a JOIN button that puts you straight into their game.
For LAN games the button only works if you're on the same network as them.

title: Friend Game Announcements
items: Join a Warcraft III lobby and your mutual friends get a whisper naming the game, like the old Battle.net — LAN games say so too.
Turn it off in Settings → Warcraft III → Friend Announcements.

title: Warcraft III Presence
items: Your friends can now see what you are up to in Warcraft III — sitting in a lobby, loading, or in a game.
The lobby or map name shows with it — friends see you in the lobby “castle fight df”, or playing “Castle Fight: Perks Edition v9.53”.
It appears on your profile card and in /whois, next to your Steam game.
Nothing is sent to Warcraft III — ElderKeep only reads what the game already reports — and it clears the moment you close the game.

title: Warcraft III JOIN On Any Install
items: Warcraft III JOIN now works on a normal Warcraft III install — until now it only worked if you also happened to have W3Champions installed.
Settings now tells you whether Warcraft III was found but can’t be hooked, instead of wrongly reporting the game as not installed.
Added a “Locate Warcraft III…” button in Settings, for installs in a custom folder that ElderKeep can’t find on its own.

title: WC3 LAN Cleanup
items: Unhosted Warcraft III LAN games now disappear from the LAN screen within seconds instead of lingering for minutes.
Removing one game's advert no longer disturbs a game you're in the middle of joining.

title: One-Click WC3 LAN Joining
items: Hit JOIN on a Warcraft III LAN game and ElderKeep now takes you straight in — it starts the game if needed, switches it to LAN and joins the lobby for you.

If ElderKeep can't drive the game (not on Windows, or you haven't enabled the Warcraft III bridge), it still broadcasts the game so you can join from Custom Games → Local Area Network, exactly as before.
Fixed LAN games hosted on your own network showing up but failing to join with "the game could not be found".
ElderKeep now warns you when a second copy of it is running, instead of silently failing to control Warcraft III.

title: Duplicate Logins Fixed
items: 👥 Signing in on a second device no longer breaks the first — the extra session now shows as Name#2, Name#3… just like Warcraft III.
💬 Whispers, calls and invites reach the device you aimed them at, instead of only whichever one signed in most recently.
🔐 Encrypted whispers no longer break when you are signed in on two devices at once.
🔔 Your friends no longer see you sign in and out again each time you open a second device.
🛡️ Tightened clan moderation and channel ban checks so they apply correctly to every session.

title: Android Updates That Finish
items: 📱 Android updates no longer hang forever on "Downloading update…". Tapping the banner could leave it stuck with no prompt and no way to retry — the update had actually downloaded, but the install step failed silently.
💬 The update banner now tells you what went wrong and lets you tap to retry, instead of sitting there with no explanation.
🔐 Asks for the "install unknown apps" permission when it's needed, then finishes the update automatically when you come back.
⚠️ A failed download is now detected instead of being treated as successful.
🐛 Fixed a startup error on mobile that interrupted app initialization.

title: Crash Reporting Made Private + Off Switch
items: 🔒 Crash reporting no longer uploads memory snapshots. The versions that added it (v4.9.132–133) could have sent a crash dump containing decrypted whispers and encryption keys — that is now switched off, and only the plain error message and stack trace are ever sent.
🎚️ New setting: Settings → General → Send Crash Reports — on by default, turn it off any time and nothing is sent at all.
🪶 Removed unused error-reporting code from the server, shrinking the server installer by about 9 MB.
📱 Android version bumped so phones actually see the update notification again.

title: Critical Fix: Login/Settings Appearing Missing
items: 🚨 Fixed a v4.9.132 bug where your login and settings could appear missing after updating — a startup-order issue pointed the app at the wrong data folder. Nothing was ever deleted; this update points it back at the right one.

title: Warcraft III Cleanup + Crash Reporting
items: ⚔️ Warcraft III settings moved to their own dedicated page — previously tucked under Settings → Steam.
🧪 The Warcraft III JOIN feature is now clearly marked BETA — it's still being tested.
🐛 Fixed: opening Settings → Warcraft III didn't refresh the JOIN bridge status line.
📡 Added crash/error reporting behind the scenes, so bugs can be caught and fixed faster.

title: Leftover Cleanup Button
items: 🧹 Fixed: if ElderKeep left files in your Warcraft III folder, Settings → Steam now shows Remove ElderKeep's files — before, it only offered removal while the feature was switched on, which is never when leftovers exist.

title: Cleans Up After Itself
items: 🧹 Fixed: Turn off & undo left two files behind in Warcraft III's folder if they came from the short-lived v4.9.128 experiment. It now removes them properly.
🛡️ A real Warcraft III webui folder is still never deleted — only a folder containing nothing but ElderKeep's own two files.

title: Honest Warcraft III Support
items: 🧪 Removed the “create the webui folder” option added in v4.9.128 — it was flagged as untested and it turned out Warcraft III ignores the created folder, so it could never have worked.
🧹 If v4.9.128 created that folder for you, ElderKeep now tells you and Settings → Steam → Turn off & undo deletes it again.
💬 Installs that can't be hooked now say so up front instead of offering a button that does nothing. The lobby list and ⧉ copy work as normal.

title: Warcraft III JOIN on More Installs
items: ⚔️ Warcraft III installs that have no webui folder can now use JOIN too — ElderKeep offers to create that folder for you (one small file, nothing overwritten).
↩️ One-click undo: Settings → Steam → Turn off & undo deletes exactly what ElderKeep created and nothing else.
🧪 Heads up: this path is new. If your game's menu ever looks wrong after enabling it, turn it off and everything goes back as it was.

title: Clearer Warcraft III Messages
items: 💬 Fixed: if your Warcraft III can't be hooked, ElderKeep now says so and why, instead of wrongly claiming the game isn't installed or that you picked the wrong folder.
ℹ️ Some Warcraft III installs load their menu from the game's own data files and have no webui folder. One-click JOIN isn't possible on those — the lobby list and ⧉ copy still work normally.

title: Finds Warcraft III Anywhere
items: 🔎 Fixed: “Warcraft III wasn’t found on this PC” even though it was installed — ElderKeep now checks Blizzard's own install records and other drives, not just the default Program Files folder.
📂 If it still can't find it, you can point ElderKeep at your Warcraft III folder yourself with the new Locate Warcraft III… button.
🧩 Also works with PTR installs and with the game installed on any drive.

title: Hotfix: v4.9.124 Wouldn't Start
items: 🚑 Fixed: v4.9.124 failed to start at all — a file needed by the new Warcraft III feature was left out of the installer. If you were stuck on a client that wouldn't open, this release fixes it.
🛡️ The Warcraft III bridge now fails safely: if any part of it is missing, that one feature switches itself off instead of stopping ElderKeep from launching.

title: Warcraft III: One-Click Join
items: ⚔️ New: press JOIN on any Warcraft III lobby and ElderKeep puts you straight in — starting the game through Battle.net first if it isn't running.
🎮 Works from the main menu or with the game already open — you no longer have to be sitting in the Multiplayer screen.

🔒 Off by default, and it asks first: joining needs one line added to a Warcraft III file, and ElderKeep shows you exactly what it changes before touching anything. Turn it off any time in Settings, and uninstalling removes it.
🤝 Other add-ons are left alone — W3Champions keeps working exactly as before.
🐛 Fixed: the Warcraft III lobby list was always empty — the old source stopped publishing games, so ElderKeep now uses a live one (80+ lobbies at any time).
🐛 Fixed: the Roblox game list sometimes loaded only partly, or not at all, because of rate limiting.

title: Play Games: Steam Server Lists
items: 🐛 Fixed: PC server lists came back empty for every game — BattleMetrics closed its API to free use, so ElderKeep now pulls server lists from Steam by default.
🎮 Server lists work for 20+ games including CS2, Rust, ARK, DayZ, 7 Days to Die, Valheim, Project Zomboid, Arma 3 and Garry's Mod.

🚧 Games with no public server list (ARK: Survival Ascended, Palworld, Squad, Arma Reforger, BattleBit, Conan Exiles, SCUM) now say so and point you at Join by IP instead of showing a misleading error.
⚡ Server lists download about 95% smaller (3.5 MB down to 0.17 MB) — faster browsing and far less load on the server.
💬 Error messages now explain what actually went wrong instead of always blaming your connection.

title: Auto-Scroll Fixed
items: 🐛 Fixed: chat stopped following new messages and you had to scroll down by hand — one stray scroll switched auto-scroll off for the rest of the session.
🖼️ Screenshots and GIFs no longer leave you parked above them — the log follows once the image finishes loading.
📜 Opening a channel whose history has screenshots now lands you on the newest message.
⚙️ Coming back from Settings or Play Games returns you to the bottom of the chat.
👀 Scrolling up to read is still respected — new messages never yank you down, and the "▼ New messages" pill brings you back.
📚 Older messages are no longer trimmed away while you're reading back through them.

title: @Mentions & Channel Links
items: 💬 Type @ to mention someone — a list appears as you type, with arrow keys to pick and Enter or Tab to insert.
🔔 Being mentioned highlights the message, plays a sound and flashes the taskbar — even when it lands in a channel you are not in.
🔴 Unread mention counts show on each channel in the Channel tab and in the channel browser.
#️⃣ Type # to link a channel — click it to jump straight there.
📣 @everyone and @here ping a whole clan or channel, behind a new "Mention Everyone" permission in Clan Config (off by default).
🔊 New "Mention Sound" toggle in Settings.

title: Readable Replies
items: 🎨 The quoted message above a reply is now the same colour as normal chat text instead of a dim grey — much easier to read at a glance.

title: Proper Replies
items: ✨ Replies are real now — the message you answer shows on its own line above your name, instead of a "> quote" pasted into your text. Click Reply and a "Replying to …" bar appears above the input; ✕ cancels it.
🐛 Fixed: the message toolbar vanished the moment you moved the mouse to click Add Reaction or the ⋯ menu. It now stays put until you are done.
✨ Add Reaction opens the full emoji picker straight away, and whatever you pick joins your quick-reaction row — 👍 ❤️ 😂 stay pinned first, recents fill the rest.
🐛 Fixed: a reply whose original was deleted now reads "Original message was deleted" instead of losing the reference.

title: Reply, Copy & Delete
items: ✨ Redesigned the message toolbar — hovering a message now shows a proper button bar at its top-right with quick reactions, add reaction, reply and a ⋯ menu. The old button was tiny and easy to miss.
✨ Added a message menu on the ⋯ button with Add Reaction, Reply, Copy Text, Copy Link and Delete Message.
✨ Reply drops a quote of the message into your chat box, so you can answer underneath it.
✨ You can now delete your own messages. They disappear for everyone, along with any reactions on them — and only ever your own.
✨ Copy Text copies a message, and Copy Link shows up whenever the message contains a link.
📱 On phones, long-press a message to open the same menu — there is no hover on a touchscreen.

title: Message Reactions
items: ✨ Added message reactions — hover any message, click the ☺+ button and pick an emoji. Click a reaction to add yours or take it back, and hover one to see everyone who reacted.
✨ A quick bar covers the usual suspects, and the ＋ button opens the full emoji picker if you want something else.
✨ Reactions stick around — they come back with the message history when you rejoin a channel, in public channels, clan channels and clan chat alike.

🐛 Fixed: the "What's New" panel did not appear when you updated to 4.9.116. It compares against the version you last ran, which only started being recorded in that release — so there was nothing to compare against. Working from this update on.

🐛 Fixed: screen-share audio could sound robotic and drift behind the video, most noticeably while sharing a game window. Audio now gets network priority over video instead of being starved by it, and the audio buffer primes and self-corrects rather than settling permanently at two seconds of delay.

🛠 Screen share now defaults to the VP9 codec. H264 is only faster where your GPU actually exposes a hardware encoder — on hardware where it quietly falls back to software it was the slowest option of all, and VP9 encodes about twice as fast. The share panel shows HW or SW so you can tell which you are getting, and you can still pick H264 in Settings → Screen Share.
🛠 The screen-share upload budget now applies even with a single viewer, so one watcher can no longer saturate your uplink.

title: Patch Notes & Chat History
items: ✨ Added in-app patch notes — a "What's New" panel now appears once after each update, with the full release history in Settings → Patch Notes and a /patchnotes command in chat.
✨ Chat history now works in every channel — Town Square and other public channels keep the last 30 days, so you can see what you missed instead of joining to an empty log.
✨ Images and GIFs now stay in history too, instead of disappearing the moment you switched channels.
🎨 Replayed history now renders links, embeds and image previews the same way live messages do — previously old messages came back as plain text.
🐛 Fixed: "Continue offline" on the login screen left the app half-loaded with an empty channel and no users.

title: Global Hotkeys
items: ✨ Added a new Settings → Hotkeys panel with 9 rebindable shortcuts: Profile, Settings, Play Games, Volume Ducking toggle, Chat Bubbles toggle, Mute Microphone, Deafen, Screenshare, and Leave Voice Channel.
✨ Hotkeys fire system-wide — even while another window or game has focus, same as Push-to-Talk — and support modifier combos like Ctrl+Shift+M.
🛠 Conflict detection stops you from binding the same combo to two different actions, or to your Push-to-Talk key.

title: Ducking Gets a Duck Fixer-Upper
items: 🐛 Fixed: volume ducking no longer stayed active while you were muted — it now only ducks (and holds) while you're unmuted, and releases immediately the moment you mute mid-conversation.

✨ Added an optional Fade Transition for Volume Ducking — smoothly ramps the volume down and back up instead of snapping instantly, with an adjustable Fade Speed slider. Off by default; not recommended for speaker users, since the gradual fade can let your mic pick up other apps' audio a bit longer before it lowers.

title: Clan Permissions
items: ✨ Added a Chieftain-only Clan Config panel to set exactly what Shamans, Grunts, and Peons can each do — kick, ban, invite, manage channels, remove members, control the bot, and promote/demote ranks.
✨ Replaced the old "Shaman Channels" toggle with separate Channel Edit and Channel Remove permissions, grantable to any rank.
🎨 Removed the standalone "Set Rank" button — click a member's name to change their rank, same as everywhere else.
🎨 Redesigned the Clan tab's action buttons — smaller icons instead of the old oversized buttons.

title: GIFs Are Back
items: 🐛 Fixed: GIF search showed nothing for everyone — Tenor (the old provider) permanently shut down its API. GIFs are now powered by Klipy.
✨ GIFs now work automatically for everyone — no personal API key needed, the server handles it for you.
🔑 Added an optional personal Klipy API key (Settings → Behavior) for anyone who wants their own search quota.
🛠 Server admins can now set a Klipy API key directly in the ElderKeep Server app, next to the Steam API key.

title: Clan Channel Bug Fixes
items: 🐛 Fixed: creating or renaming a clan channel could get wiped out mid-typing if anyone in the clan changed channels or went away/back at the same time.
✨ Fixed: a flickering hover highlight on clan channel rows and buttons, caused by the same underlying issue.

title: Clan Channel Refinements
items: 👥 Removed the duplicate member list — the Users panel now hides while you're in a clan channel, since the channel list already shows who's where.
🎨 Members in the channel list now show their icon, clan tag, level, and rank color — matching the rest of the app.
📐 The channel list now fills the whole panel instead of scrolling early, so more channels are visible at once.
📜 A channel with a lot of people scrolls on its own without pushing the rest of the list around.

title: Clan Channel Polish
items: 👥 Clan channels now show who's sitting in them, so you can see where everyone is before you join.
📜 The channel list only appears while you're in one of your clan's channels — no longer shown from Town Square.
➕ Adding a channel is now a proper "+ Add Channel" button instead of a small plus icon.
✨ Right-click menus on clan and voice channels restyled to match the rest of the app.

title: Clan Channels
items: 🔊 Voice channels are now purely voice — switching between them no longer moves your chat.
💬 New Channels list in the Channel tab: your clan's Main channel plus up to 10 chat channels you can join.
⚜ Chieftains can add, rename, remove and reorder clan channels from the Channel tab.
◆ Chieftains can let Shamans manage channels too, with a single toggle in the Clan tab.
📜 Each clan channel keeps its own chat history.
🐛 Fixed: older clan chat history was shown as clan chat regardless of where it was posted.

title: Snappier Voice Channels
items: ⚡ Joining, switching between, or leaving a clan voice channel no longer plays the full-screen channel transition — moving around voice is instant.

title: Voice Channel Chat
items: 💬 Every clan voice channel now has its own chat channel — join "General" voice and your chat follows you to Clan [TAG] General.
🚪 Leave voice and you're returned to the channel you were in before.
🔒 Voice channel chats are clan-members-only — only your clan can read them.
✏️ Renaming a voice channel relabels its chat to match — the conversation stays put.
🏠 Your clan's main channel is unchanged: it's still home when you're not in voice.

title: Fantasy UI Overhaul
items: 🏛 Complete visual overhaul — carved stone frames, gold inlay and mossy corners across every window.
⚔ New hand-crafted artwork for buttons, tabs and panels throughout the app.
🔮 Login, Settings, Profile and Play Games all restyled to match.
🌲 Chat now shows the forest and fireflies edge-to-edge, with the channel header floating over the scene.
🖤 New "Black" background option for a clean, distraction-free look — Settings → Appearance → Background.
🐛 Fixed: the Profile close button was invisible and unclickable.
🐛 Fixed: the Profile rank title was hidden behind the portrait.
🐛 Fixed: the Play Games close button was hard to see.
📦 Smaller download — design source art no longer ships with the app.

title: Firefly Forest Background
items: 🌲 New Firefly Forest background — fireflies drift, orbit and flash over an enchanted moonlit forest.
✨ Firefly Forest is now the default background — Battlefield and Gothic Castle are still available in Settings → Appearance → Background.
🏰 If you previously picked Gothic Castle it stays; untouched default backgrounds switch to the new scene.

title: Screen Share Power-Up
items: ⇄ Change source mid-share from the share panel — swap between screens and windows while viewers stay connected, no re-invites.
📶 New: Total Upload Budget setting — splits your upload fairly when several people watch (Settings → Screen Share).
🔴 Red LIVE badge on voice members who are sharing — click it to watch.
📊 The viewer window now shows connection stats (bitrate + packet loss) so you can tell whose connection is struggling.
🎞 New: H265/HEVC codec option for modern GPUs (experimental — falls back to H264 automatically).
⚠ One-time warning when your share is software-encoded, with a tip to switch to H264 for GPU encoding.
🔔 Screen share invites now play a sound, and you can "Always accept" trusted friends (Settings → Screen Share → Privacy).
🧹 Removed the Min Bitrate setting — it never had any effect.
🤖 Android: fixed in-app updates never appearing — phones will get update banners again from now on.

title: Settings Overhaul
items: ⚙ Settings is now a full-screen panel — grouped sidebar, bigger text, and instant auto-save (the Save button is gone).
🔎 New: search box in Settings finds any option across all tabs.
🎨 New: visual theme picker with color previews.
🕐 New: timestamp color palette & opacity slider — timestamps are actually readable now.
💾 Accent color, message colors, title font and title bar height now survive restarts.
🧹 Fixed: the Reset button now truly resets all settings.
🎙 Fixed: several voice settings (mic boost, sensitivity, join/leave sounds…) only saved if you pressed Save.
🤖 Fixed: both noise suppressors could run at once on fresh installs — RNNoise is now the single default.
🪟 Window buttons (minimize/maximize/close) restyled to match the gold theme.

title: Clan Rank Color Rework
items: ⚜ Clan ranks decluttered — only officers are color-coded now: Chieftain gold, Shamans purple; Grunts and Peons show as normal names.
✨ Both officer ranks carry a golden glow around their name — in clan chat, the clan member list and the user list of clan channels.
🧹 Fixed Shamans looking almost identical to the Chieftain in clan chat (both were gold before); rank section headers are now quiet gray.

title: Member List Redesign
items: ✨ Users, Friends, Clan and Voice lists redesigned with a clean flat look — the old beveled boxes and glow borders are gone.
👥 User rows reordered: portrait → name → [clan tag] → level, with rounded portrait icons.
🟢 Friends show online/offline as a status dot on their portrait plus colored status text; the call button got a proper phone icon.
🎖 Clan officers now highlighted with a gold name; your joined voice room gets a soft green tint.

title: Voice Icon Overhaul
items: 🎙 All voice controls redesigned — Mute, Deafen, Share Screen, End Call and Disconnect now use crisp new icons instead of emoji, with a clear white-glyph + red-slash style for muted/deafened/disconnect.
👥 Member list: the mute/deafen indicators next to usernames are bigger and clearly visible (they were tiny before).
🔇 Matching icons for the call host's force-mute button, the clan moderation menu and the per-user volume sliders.

title: Voice Mute Icon Persistence Fix
items: 🔇 Fixed mute icons not persisting in voice channels — when a muted user rejoined or switched channels, everyone else lost sight of their mute state.
🔇 Fixed a race where a user's mute status could be dropped right as they joined — icons no longer start blank.
🔕 Deafen icons get the same fixes.

title: Screen-Share False Decline & Screenshot Upload Fix
items: 🖥 Fixed a false "declined your screen share" message (and brief stream drop) appearing ~30 s after someone started watching via the 👁 View link.
🖥 A stale decline can no longer disconnect a viewer who is already watching.
💬 Large pasted screenshots are now compressed before upload — 1440p/4K screenshots no longer fail with "request entity too large".
🖼 Server: image upload limit raised from 8 MB to 20 MB, with a clear error message instead of a server error.

title: Game-Mode PTT Reliability Fix
items: 🎙 Fixed Game-Mode PTT sometimes getting stuck on "initializing" and never asking for the one-time admin approval — setup now repairs itself and prompts reliably.
🎙 If Game-Mode PTT can't start (e.g. blocked by antivirus or policy), push-to-talk now automatically falls back to standard mode and tells you, instead of silently leaving you without PTT.

title: Game-Mode PTT & Chat Scroll Fix
items: 🎙 New "Game-Mode PTT" (Settings → Voice): push-to-talk now works over games run as administrator (e.g. World of Warcraft) without running ElderKeep itself as admin — so window screen-sharing keeps working.
🛡 Guidance throughout the app now steers away from Administrator mode (it blocks sharing other apps' windows); Game-Mode PTT replaces the only reason it was needed.
💬 Fixed chat not always scrolling to the newest message — it now reliably pins to the bottom, including for image and embed messages.

title: Win10 Full-Screen Share Fix
items: 🖥 Fixed sharing your entire screen failing with "Could not start video source" on Windows 10 when Modern Window Capture (WGC) was enabled.
🖥 Full-screen and window sharing now both work with WGC on — full-screen capture uses the reliable legacy path while windows keep the modern capturer.

title: Voice Auto-Leave on Channel Switch
items: 🎙 Leaving a text channel now automatically disconnects you from that channel's voice room — no more lingering in a voice channel after you've moved on.
📞 Private and group calls stay connected when you switch channels, so your call isn't dropped just because you browse around.

title: Win10 Window Share Fix & Clan Invite Timeout
items: 🖥 Fixed sharing a specific window on Windows 10 failing with "Could not start video source" — you can now screen share individual windows, not just the whole screen.
⚜ Clan invites now expire after 30 seconds if dismissed or unanswered, so you can re-invite someone without being blocked by a stuck "pending invite".
👋 New users now get a short welcome guide in Town Square explaining how to join channels and clans.

title: Server Auto-Start & Voice Echo Fix
items: 🚀 ElderKeep Server can now start the server automatically when the app opens — flip on "Auto-start" in the server window's settings (pairs with adding the app to Windows startup for hands-off hosting).
🔊 Fixed a voice bug where someone could be heard twice (doubled/echoed) after the connection re-negotiated.

title: Screen Share Viewer Controls & Win10 Capture Fix
items: 🖥 See who's watching — viewers of your screen share now appear right on the live preview, with a live count.
🔔 Get a sound and an on-screen alert the moment someone starts watching your screen.
🚫 Remove a viewer from your screen share with one click — kicked viewers can't rejoin until you re-add them.

🪟 New "Modern Window Capture (WGC)" option for Windows 10 — fixes windows that showed up black when shared (games, browsers, Discord and other GPU-accelerated apps). Turn it on in Settings → Screen Share, then restart.

title: VPN & Screen Share Help Tip
items: New /help tip: if voice or screen share won't connect through a VPN (e.g. Mullvad), turn the VPN off for the call or split-tunnel ElderKeep so its traffic goes direct.

title: Voice & Screen Share: VPN/TURN Support
items: Screen share & voice can now relay through a TURN server, fixing connections that failed behind VPNs (e.g. Mullvad) or strict firewalls.
TURN is configurable in the ElderKeep Server settings — use an external provider or run the bundled self-hosted TURN server.
Clan tab now shows just usernames for a cleaner member list (removed level badges).

title: New App Icon
items: Brand-new ElderKeep app icon (a tower with a microphone) across Windows, the server console, and Android.
Windows taskbar & Task Manager now show the ElderKeep icon and name instead of the generic Electron icon.
Updated Android home-screen / app-drawer launcher icon.

title: Voice Channel Moderation
items: Chieftains and Shamans can now kick members from a clan voice channel — right- or left-click a member and choose "Kick from voice".
Chieftains and Shamans can force-mute or un-mute members in clan voice; a moderator mute silences that member for everyone.
Voice moderation respects rank — the Chieftain can't be moderated, and only a Chieftain can moderate a Shaman.
Android: the app now updates itself in-app (no more manual APK installs).

title: Server Admin Console
items: The server owner can now manage accounts directly from the ElderKeep Server window — including resetting a locked-out player's password — via a new admin command bar (e.g. /resetpassword username).
Lost your password AND your recovery codes? Ask the server owner to reset it for you.

title: Account Recovery & Instant Connect
items: Recover your account with one-time backup codes — shown when you sign up, plus a "Forgot password?" option on the login screen.
New Settings → Account & Security tab to change your password or generate fresh recovery codes anytime.
New users now connect to the public server automatically — no need to enter a server address.
Voice: Settings lists all your microphones and speakers and remembers the ones you pick.
Fix: "Forgot password?" is now an easy-to-click button.

title: Save Password & Auto Connect
items: New "Save password" option on the sign-in screen — remembers your password between sessions.
New "Auto connect" option — signs you in automatically on launch, but only once the update check confirms you're on the latest build.
Saved passwords are now encrypted using your operating system's secure credential vault (Windows DPAPI) — never stored in plain text.

title: Chat-Hosted WC3 Games & Dark Title Bar
items: Host Warcraft III LAN games right from chat with w3bot — pick a map with -map and host it with -pub in your clan channel.
Bot accounts can now connect to ElderKeep and appear in chat with a BOT badge; hosting is limited to authorized admins.
Window title bar restyled in dark theme to match the rest of the app.

title: Clan Status & Voice Glow Fixes
items: Clan tab now updates online/offline status live — members show online the instant they connect and offline when they leave (fixes stale/inverted glows).
Voice speaking glow now self-clears via heartbeat + watchdog, so the green indicator no longer sticks.

title: Profile Hero Cards & Status Glow
items: Profiles have been redesigned as a Warcraft-style hero card — a level-colored glowing portrait frame, a hero-class title, and an animated XP bar.
Profiles now track real stats: messages sent, voice time, and games joined.
Friends and clan lists now glow green when a member is online and red when offline, so status is easy to see at a glance.
Chat bubbles now show over fullscreen games.
Tidied up the clan tab buttons.

title: TLS Encryption & Chat Copying
items: Connections are now encrypted: the app connects to the new server address (wss://elderkeep.duckdns.org) automatically after updating — no action needed
Server Address field now accepts wss:// and https:// for TLS-secured servers
Your own encrypted whispers are now readable — no more [encrypted] for messages you sent
Chat text can be highlighted with the mouse and copied (Ctrl+C, or right-click to copy instantly)
Fixed links opening accidentally when releasing a text selection on top of them
Server: rate limits now see real client IPs when running behind a reverse proxy

title: Auto-Rejoin After Server Restart
items: If the server restarts or your connection drops, you now automatically rejoin the channel you were in — no more landing in limbo.
Voice channels reconnect too: once the connection is back, you're placed straight back into your previous voice channel.
Fixed a reconnect quirk that could briefly create a phantom voice connection to yourself.

title: Per-Window Audio Capture
items: Sharing a specific window now captures only that window's audio — music, voice chat and other apps stay private.
Entire-screen shares still include all desktop audio (except ElderKeep's own voice chat).
If per-window audio capture isn't available on your system, the share continues without audio instead of leaking everything.

title: Smoother Screen Share & Invite Consent
items: Screen sharing is much smoother — fixed a hidden GPU encoder bottleneck that capped framerate.
New Auto FPS Guard: automatically lowers stream resolution when your GPU can't keep up, and restores it when it can (Settings → Screen Share).
Screen share invites now ask permission — a Watch / Decline prompt appears instead of the stream opening automatically.
New privacy setting: Block Screen Share Invites — auto-declines invite spam; you can still watch via the 👁 View button.
Sharing panel now shows live encoder info (HW/SW, codec) to help diagnose stream quality.
Faster window capture on Windows 11.
Fixed screen share notifications appearing squashed at the bottom of the window.

title: Cursor Flicker Fix
items: Fixed a glitchy bug where the mouse cursor rapidly flickered between shapes when hovering buttons, profiles, and list items.
Server rows and game cards in Play Games no longer shift under the cursor on hover (which caused the flicker).
Hover highlights are preserved — borders and shadows still respond, the elements just no longer jump.

title: Browse Channels & Clan Voice Renaming
items: New "Channel" button (top of the chat) opens the ElderKeep Channel Selection window — browse Town Square and every clan channel in one place.
Live online counts per channel, a search box, current-channel highlighting, and double-click to join.
Clan voice channels can now be renamed by Chieftains and Shamans.

title: Collapsible Settings & Town Square Welcome
items: Settings groups can now be collapsed — click any group header to compact it behind a −/+ toggle, keeping the Settings panel tidy. Your collapsed/expanded choices are remembered between launches.
Town Square now greets you by name when you join, shows your current server ping, and points you to /help for the full command list.

title: Customizable Chat Bubbles
items: Chat Bubbles now have colour themes (Gold, Crimson, Emerald, Sapphire, Amethyst, Mono) plus custom colour pickers for the background, border, sender name, message text and accent bar.
New per-type tints for whisper, emote, and system/game bubbles.
New accent bar on every bubble that also signals the message type at a glance.
New "Pop For" filter lets you choose which message kinds appear as bubbles (chat, whispers, emotes, login/logout, game joins).
Clickable bubbles — click a bubble to whisper the sender, or click a game-join bubble to jump straight into the game.
New Fade Duration control and two extra screen positions (top-center, bottom-center).
Fixed: custom bubble colours no longer reset to defaults when you restart the app.

title: Push-to-Talk & settings fix
items: Fixed your Push-to-Talk key and other voice settings resetting to defaults after restarting or updating the app — settings now save reliably.
If your PTT key was affected, set it once more after this update and it'll stick.

title: Linux: WC3 LAN discovery fix
items: Linux: improved Warcraft III LAN game discovery — the game is now announced on every network interface, so WC3 finds it even when VPNs or virtual network adapters are present.

title: Linux: WC3 LAN join & screen-share fixes
items: Linux: Joining a Warcraft III LAN game now works — it shows up in WC3's LAN browser like on Windows.
Linux: The screen-share window now opens reliably when you watch someone share (it could previously stay hidden).

title: Screen Share Viewer Overhaul
items: Screen-share viewer now has a volume slider (0–200%) and a mute button, and remembers your volume between sessions.
The viewer shows a live FPS counter and resolution, and can go fullscreen (⛶ / F11).
The viewer auto-reconnects if the stream drops, with a manual retry if that fails.

title: Voice Call Room & Fixes
items: Active voice calls now appear as a room beneath your voice channels — see exactly who's in the call at a glance.
Plus voice call fixes and polish.

title: Voice Call Fixes
items: Fixed incoming calls vanishing before you could pick up when the caller was already in a voice channel.
Fixed accepting a call from a channel dropping you right back out — you now join properly and can see everyone in the call.
Switching between voice channels no longer momentarily bounces you out of the channel you just joined.

title: Play Games Server Browser Overhaul
items: Load more servers — browse far beyond the old 100-server cap on every PC game and Roblox.
New ⚡ All (Steam) mode pulls a game's entire Steam server list at once (add a free key in Settings → Steam).
Non-Steam games (ARK: Survival Ascended, Arma Reforger, Squad, Palworld…) auto-fall back to BattleMetrics with a clear note.
New filters: Country/Region, player-count range (hide empty/full), map, and sort by rank.
Redesigned server browser — card-style rows, banner game headers, and a live summary bar.
Fixed unreadable (white-on-white) filter dropdowns.

title: Voice Calls Reworked — Group Calls & Host Controls
items: Voice calls are now group calls — start a call and add as many people as you want.
Call hosts can add or remove members on the fly, and mute anyone for the whole room.
The active call now lives in the Voice tab and disappears the instant the call ends.
If the host drops or leaves, the call keeps going — host duties pass to the next member automatically.
Calling someone on Do Not Disturb now auto-declines politely instead of ringing them.
Missed, declined, and unanswered calls now leave a note in your chat.
New Call button next to online friends in the Friends list.

title: Elderwand is now ElderKeep
items: Elderwand is now ElderKeep — same app, same friends, new name.
App name, window title, tray, and installer all updated to ElderKeep.
Heads-up: because the app's identity changed, this installs fresh alongside your old Elderwand — uninstall the old one.
Website and download links moved to the new ElderKeep pages.

title: GIF Auto-Scroll Fix
items: Fixed the chat not scrolling down to show a GIF or image after it finishes loading — no more manual scrolling.

title: Emoji & GIF Chat + Ducking Overhaul
items: New emoji picker — browse 1,300+ emojis by category, search by keyword, and a recents row, right from the chat box.
Send GIFs — a new GIF button with Tenor search drops animated GIFs straight into chat for everyone. Optional Tenor API key in Settings → Chat for extra reliability.
Volume Ducking rebuilt — fixes other apps' audio getting stuck low or scrambled when several people talk at once, and stops your own voice chat from being lowered.
Volume Ducking now has Suppressed and Normal volume sliders, a "suppress on my own voice" toggle, and a whitelist of apps to never lower (e.g. games).
Pasted Tenor and Giphy GIF links now preview inline in chat.

title: WC3 LAN Games in Play Games
items: WC3 LAN games now live in the Play Games browser — open the new "WC3 LAN" card to see active games and join in one click.
Removed the old WC3 game strip that used to sit above the chat log.
New setting: get a chat notification with a Join button when a friend opens a WC3 LAN game (Settings → Behavior, on by default).
Fixed WC3 games staying listed forever after the host closed — stale games are now cleared automatically.

title: WC3 Remote Join
items: Friends can now join your w3bot-hosted WC3 Reforged games directly from ElderKeep — no ZeroTier or VPN required.
A WC3 game bar appears above chat whenever a game is open, showing the map name and current player count.
Clicking JOIN broadcasts the game over local mDNS so WC3's LAN browser picks it up instantly.
w3announce.exe is now bundled with the ElderKeep installer.

title: Clan Bot Visibility
items: The clan bot ([TAG]-Bot) now appears in the channel user list when you are in your clan channel — shown at the top of the Shaman tier with a green name and BOT badge.
The clan bot now always sorts to the top of the Shaman section in the clan panel, above online and offline members.

title: Clan Bots
items: Every clan now automatically gets its own bot ([TAG]-Bot) as a Shaman member of the clan.
Bots respond to ! commands in the clan channel — the trigger character is changeable with !settrigger.
Moderation commands: !kick, !ban, !unban, !shitlist, !unshitlist, !tagban, !votekick, !voteban, !mute, !unmute.
Fun commands: !8ball, !roll, !flip, !duel, !rps, !trivia, !fact.
Utility commands: !ping, !seen, !info, !ranks, !help, !time, !uptime.
Bot badge shown in green in chat messages and in the clan member list.
Bots are created automatically for all existing clans on server startup.

title: Clan History & Channel Logging
items: Clan channels now keep a 30-day chat history — messages are saved server-side and restored automatically when you log in.
Both regular clan channel messages and /clan broadcasts are saved. History appears in the chat after joining your clan channel, marked with a separator line.
Messages in history display the correct original timestamp (HH:MM for today, MM/DD HH:MM for older messages). Messages older than 30 days are pruned automatically.

title: Friend Notifications, Secure Login & Game Browser Polish
items: Friend login/logout notifications: when a mutual friend (both have each other added) logs in or out, you receive a whisper notification — 'Your friend has logged into ElderKeep.' or 'Your friend has exited ElderKeep.'
Remember Me now stores your session token securely instead of your password. The app auto-logs you in on launch and resumes where you left off.
Username availability is now checked live as you type during registration — a green checkmark or red X appears immediately.
Play Games panel is now resizable: drag the bottom-right corner to scale the window. Size is saved across sessions.
PC game server list now shows 25 servers per page with navigation controls — much faster to browse large server lists.
Server: login, registration, and username-check endpoints now have rate limiting to prevent brute-force and spam.
Server: API access restricted to localhost and the app — no longer accessible from any origin.

title: Town Square, UI Cleanup & Bot Removal
items: Removed the news/home view. The app now opens directly into chat.
Users without a clan are automatically placed in Town Square on login. Clan members are automatically placed in their clan channel as before.
Town Square greets new users with a welcome message explaining how to create a clan and use key commands.
Removed the Channels button and the news nav bar from the home screen.
Removed the Home button from the header.
Removed all test bots from the server.
Header buttons (Profile, Play Games, Settings) are slightly smaller.

title: PTT Improvements, Watch Stream & Settings Fix
items: PTT now supports mouse buttons — middle click, right click, and side buttons (Mouse 4 / Mouse 5) can be used as Push-to-Talk keys. Right-click context menu is suppressed during key capture.

PTT key capture also recognizes many more keyboard keys that previously did not register: arrow keys, numpad keys (Num0–Num9, Num+, Num-, etc.), Insert, Delete, Home, End, Page Up, Page Down, Print Screen, Scroll Lock, and Pause.

Watch Stream: clicking a user's name now shows a 'Watch Stream' option in the context menu when that user is actively sharing their screen in your voice channel. No need to wait for the notification banner.
The Watch Stream option only appears when you are in the same voice channel as the sharer and they are actively sharing.

Fixed a critical bug where settings (including PTT key, PTT mode, microphone settings, volumes, theme, and all other preferences) were not reliably saved after closing the app. Chromium's localStorage backend buffers writes lazily and can lose data on close — settings are now also written directly to disk via the main process, guaranteeing persistence.

title: Linux Support + Bug Fixes
items: Linux is now officially supported — download the AppImage (portable, runs on any distro) or the .deb package for Debian/Ubuntu.
PTT on Linux uses Electron's global shortcut system. VAD (Voice Activity Detection) is fully supported on Linux and is the recommended option.
Audio ducking is Windows-only (requires WASAPI); all other features work identically on Linux.

Fixed a critical sign-out bug: signing out then back in and joining a channel would break chat. Stale reconnect timers from the closed socket were firing after the new login and disrupting the active connection.
Auto-join clan channel on login — members are automatically placed in their clan channel when they connect, and again on each reconnect.
Added /f a [user] and /f r [user] shorthand commands to add and remove friends directly from chat. Both commands now appear in /help.
Fixed /f a and /f r not working — the client was sending the wrong field name to the server API.

title: Image & Video Previews — imgur, X, Reddit
items: imgur.com — videos and GIFs (gifv) now open in the player window via the ▶ button; regular images still display inline as before.
x.com / twitter.com — posts with photos or videos now show a thumbnail inline below the link; clicking ▶ opens the full tweet in a player window.
reddit.com — posts with images or videos now show a thumbnail inline; clicking ▶ opens the post in a player window. Direct Reddit video links (v.redd.it) play in the video player.
All inline image thumbnails use no-referrer policy to avoid hotlink blocks.

title: Image Previews in Chat
items: Images from known hosts now display inline below the link — imgur, gyazo, snipboard, Discord CDN, Reddit (i.redd.it), Puush (puu.sh), ImgBB (i.ibb.co), PostImages (i.postimg.cc), Twitter media (pbs.twimg.com), and any direct image URL (.jpg, .png, .gif, .webp, .bmp, .svg).
Click the thumbnail to open a full-size lightbox overlay. Click anywhere on the overlay to close it.
Clicking the link still opens it in your default browser as usual.
Images that fail to load are silently removed — no broken image icons.

title: Video Player Opens in New Window
items: Direct video file links (.mp4, .webm, .ogg, .mov) now open in the same dedicated player window as YouTube and Twitch — instead of the small inline player inside the chat message. The window title shows the filename.

title: Embedded Video Player — BrowserWindow
items: Clicking ▶ on a video link now opens a dedicated floating player window instead of trying to embed inside chat. This fixes YouTube, Twitch, Vimeo and Streamable not loading — those platforms block iframes served from a file:// origin, but a proper BrowserWindow has no such restriction.
Direct video file links (.mp4, .webm, etc.) still play inline inside the chat message as before.
Fixed the Embedded Video Player toggle in Settings — it now takes effect immediately without needing to press Save, and instantly shows or hides all ▶ buttons already visible in the chat.

title: Link & Embed Fix (proper)
items: Fixed clickable links and the ▶ embed button for real. The previous fix was incomplete — Electron 28 sandbox mode blocks inline onclick handlers in dynamically injected HTML entirely, regardless of quoting. Rewrote the feature using event delegation: links and embed buttons now carry data-* attributes (data-url, data-embed-type, data-embed-src) and a single delegated listener on the chat log handles all clicks. No inline JS in HTML at all.

title: Link & Embed Hotfix
items: Fixed clickable links not responding to clicks. The root cause was that JSON.stringify produces double-quoted strings which collided with the double-quoted HTML onclick attribute, causing the browser to silently ignore the handler.

Fixed the embedded video player not appearing. The same quoting bug prevented the ▶ button from calling toggleEmbed. Additionally, using esc() on embed URLs was corrupting query strings by turning & into &, breaking iframe and video src values. Both are now built via DOM APIs.

title: Links, Video Embeds & Chat Polish
items: URLs in chat messages, whispers and emotes are now clickable. Clicking a link shows a confirmation popup (Are you sure you want to open this?) with a Do not ask again option.

Video links now show a ▶ button that opens an inline player directly inside the chat message — no browser required. Supported: YouTube, Twitch streams, Twitch clips, Twitch VODs, Vimeo, Streamable, and direct .mp4/.webm/.ogg/.mov file links.
Embedded Video Player can be toggled on or off in Settings → Behavior.
Clan channels are now displayed as 'Clan TAG' everywhere in the app instead of '[TAG]'. Joining via /j also accepts the friendly format: /j Clan CsB.
Clan Message of the Day now shows as [Message of the Day] instead of [Clan MOTD] when joining a clan channel or when it is updated.

title: Chat Text Logging
items: Channel messages and emotes are now saved to a daily .txt file in your ElderKeep logs folder (same folder as the app log). Each file is named by date — e.g. 2026-05-12.txt — and each line is prefixed with a timestamp like [20:47:12].
Whispers (sent and received) are logged to a separate file — e.g. 2026-05-12-WHISPERS.txt — keeping private conversations out of the channel log.
Encrypted whispers are decrypted before logging so your local log is always human-readable. Log files are stored only on your own machine and are never sent anywhere.
Log files are found at: %APPDATA%\elderkeep-client\logs\

title: End-to-End Encrypted Whispers
items: Whispers are now end-to-end encrypted. Messages are encrypted on your device before being sent and can only be read by the intended recipient — the server routes an encrypted blob and never sees the plaintext.
Encryption uses ECDH P-256 key exchange and AES-256-GCM, both built into the browser's native Web Crypto API. No extra software or setup required.
Each account gets a unique key pair generated on first login and stored locally on your device. Your private key never leaves your machine.
Encrypted whispers are marked with a 🔒 icon in chat. If a recipient hasn't logged in since this update (no key registered yet), the message falls back to plaintext with a warning.

title: Screen Share Audio Hotfix
items: Fixed screen share audio muting the sharer's own speakers while sharing. The capture mode was set to 'loopbackWithMute' which silences your local audio while recording — changed to 'loopback' which captures system audio without affecting your own volume.

Fixed viewers not hearing the sharer's audio. The audio track was being silently dropped when it arrived before the video track (which is common). Both tracks are now properly combined regardless of which arrives first.

title: Screen Share Audio Fix
items: Fixed screen share audio — system audio (game sound, desktop audio) now actually transmits to viewers when 'Capture System Audio' is enabled. The root cause was that the internal capture handler never requested the Windows audio loopback device, so the stream had zero audio tracks regardless of the setting.

Fixed sign-in button not staying grayed out during an available update download. Previously the button unlocked as soon as an update was found, letting users sign in before noticing the update strip. The button now stays locked until the download completes, then unlocks with a prompt to restart or sign in and update on quit.

title: Voice Call Rework
items: Fixed a bug where the caller would join an undefined room on call acceptance — private calls now actually connect both participants correctly.
Outgoing calls now show a 'Calling…' overlay with the callee's name and a Cancel button, instead of just a toast notification.
Added ring tone for both caller and callee using Web Audio API. The ring plays every 2 seconds and stops automatically when the call is accepted, declined, cancelled, or ended.
Added a Cancel button for outgoing calls — the caller can now cancel before the other person picks up. The callee's incoming call notification dismisses instantly.
Added an End Call button (📵) in the voice bar. It only appears during a private call and ends the call for both participants simultaneously.
The voice bar now shows the participants' names (e.g. '📞 Alice & Bob') and 'Private Call' status text instead of the internal room ID.
If a caller disconnects while the phone is ringing, the callee's incoming call notification is now automatically dismissed.
Mute and deafen icons in the voice channel panel now update instantly when you toggle them, without needing to switch tabs.

title: Screen Share Audio & Mute/Deafen Sync Fix
items: Screen share now transmits audio. Enable 'Capture System Audio' in Settings → Screen Share → Capture, then start sharing — viewers will hear your game/desktop audio live through the stream.
Added a volume slider (0–100%) in the screen share viewer window toolbar so each viewer can control the stream audio independently.

Fixed mute and deafen status not showing for other users in the voice channel. When someone mutes or deafens themselves, their name in the voice channel list now immediately shows 🔇 or 🔕 for all other users in the room.
Mute/deafen state is now persisted on the server — if you join a channel where someone is already muted, their icon shows correctly right away without waiting for them to change state.

title: Native WebRTC Screen Share Viewer & FPS/Resolution Overhaul
items: Screen share viewer is now a true native WebRTC peer — the old JPEG encode → IPC relay pipeline has been completely removed. The viewer window receives the video stream directly via RTCPeerConnection, eliminating the 100–200 ms encoding lag and the 15 fps relay cap.

Fixed ICE candidate race condition that caused a black screen on the first View click: candidates arriving before the viewer window finished loading are now buffered and flushed once the offer has been delivered.

Resolution downscaling now actually works. Width/height constraints in getDisplayMedia are silently ignored by Electron's setDisplayMediaRequestHandler — the fix reads the real captured dimensions from the track and calculates a scaleResolutionDownBy factor for the WebRTC encoder. Example: 3440×1440 source with 1080p setting encodes at ~1920×805.

Screen share FPS raised from 15 to 28-30 fps. Root causes: WebRTC defaults screen-content tracks to 15 fps, Chromium's WebRtcAdaptiveScaling feature enforces this regardless of settings, and a 75% CPU cap on the encoder. Fixes: disabled WebRtcAdaptiveScaling, raised CPU cap to 100%, switched to getDisplayMedia via setDisplayMediaRequestHandler, applied applyConstraints post-capture, and call setParameters after connection is established to force maxFramerate.
contentHint changed from 'detail' to 'motion' — tells the encoder to prioritise frame rate over sharpness, which is correct for game and video content.
Max Frame Rate setting capped at 60 fps. Options above 60 (90, 120, 144) have been removed — they were not achievable with WebRTC screen content and caused confusion.
H264 is now the default codec (was VP9). H264 uses GPU hardware encoding on AMD/NVIDIA/Intel and is significantly faster at high resolutions. VP9 label updated to clarify it is software-only.
degradationPreference defaults to 'maintain-framerate' so the encoder drops quality rather than FPS under load.

title: Screen Share Viewer FPS Fix (for real)
items: Fixed viewer being stuck at exactly 15 fps. The cause: rAF fires at the monitor refresh rate (every 16.67ms at 60Hz), so if a single JPEG encode took ~50ms the next eligible tick snapped to exactly 3 rAF cycles = 15fps regardless of your FPS setting.
Canvas is now scaled to max 1280px wide before encoding. This cuts per-frame encode time from ~50ms to under 20ms, which is within the 33ms budget for 30fps.

Replaced the single in-flight block with a pipeline depth of 2 — toBlob snapshots the canvas at call time, so a second frame can start encoding while the first is still being read. This keeps throughput at the full target fps even if one encode takes slightly longer than one interval.

title: Screen Share Viewer FPS Fix
items: Fixed the viewer frame rate being stuck at ~12-13 fps regardless of your Max Frame Rate setting. The relay loop was hardcoded at 15 fps — it now reads ssMaxFps directly so the setting actually controls viewer fps too.
Switched frame encoding from synchronous toDataURL (which blocked the main thread and caused dropped frames) to asynchronous toBlob — the renderer no longer stalls while encoding each frame.
Reduced relay JPEG quality from 0.82 to 0.75 — visually identical for screen content but ~25% smaller per frame, reducing IPC throughput and allowing the encoder to keep up at higher frame rates.

title: Screen Share Remove Fix & Higher Quality Limits
items: Fixed Remove button in the screen share panel — clicking Remove now immediately closes the viewer's window and stops the stream on their end.
Fixed viewer window closing manually (clicking X) leaving a relay loop running in the background wasting CPU.
Max frame rate raised: 90, 120, and 144 fps options added to screen share settings.
Max bitrate raised: 25 Mbps, 50 Mbps, 100 Mbps, and a No Limit option added — suitable for LAN use.
No Limit bitrate mode omits the encoder cap entirely, letting WebRTC negotiate the highest quality the connection can sustain.

title: Screen Share Pop-Out Viewer Window
items: Screen share viewer is now a proper standalone OS window — it pops out of ElderKeep entirely so you can drag it anywhere on your desktop, move it to a second monitor, resize it freely, or keep it on top of other apps.
The old viewer overlay that appeared inside the app and got stuck behind panels has been completely removed.
Press ⛶ or F11 inside the viewer window to go fullscreen. The window stays open independently; closing it does not affect the stream.

title: Screen Share Viewer Fix (Root Cause)
items: Fixed the root cause of the viewer never appearing after clicking View: a stale peer guard on the sharer's side silently blocked every reconnect attempt after the first failed connection. The dead peer sat in memory and all subsequent View clicks were ignored.

Fixed viewer-side stale peer reuse: when a fresh offer arrived, the viewer was trying to reuse a dead/failed RTCPeerConnection instead of creating a new one, causing setRemoteDescription to fail silently.

Added visible status messages in chat at each step of the WebRTC handshake — both parties now see 'sending offer', 'connecting', 'connected', or 'failed' — making connection problems immediately obvious instead of silently failing.

title: Screen Share Incoming Notification
items: When someone starts sharing their screen, a prominent notification banner now appears at the top of the ElderKeep window — visible from any page (home, channel, wherever you are). Click 👁 View to open the stream immediately. Dismisses automatically after 20 seconds or when the share ends.

Fixed the root cause of 'viewer never appears': the old View link only appeared in the chat log, which is hidden when on the home/news page. You would never see it and the WebRTC connection would never start.
Screen share drag now uses delta-based movement — immune to multi-monitor coordinate offsets where Electron may report mouse position relative to the wrong screen origin.

title: Screen Share Viewer Fix (Deep Dive)
items: Screen share viewer now always opens in the center of the screen.
Viewer can no longer be dragged outside the viewport.
Drag cancelled on window focus loss.

title: Screen Share Viewer Fix
items: Fixed screen share viewer window spawning off-screen.
Fixed screen share viewer shooting off the edge of the screen when dragged.

title: Portrait Icons, Friends Overhaul & Profile Redesign
items: Portrait icons — every user now has a WC3-style portrait icon displayed in the channel user list, clan panel, and friends list.
User list now shows icon → level → name → [clan tag] on every row, matching the classic Battle.net layout.
Icon picker added to the profile — open Edit Profile and choose from 43 portrait icons. More icons can be added to the server at any time.
Profile modal is now significantly larger with bigger, more readable fonts throughout.
Avatar photos removed — portrait icons replace them as the primary way to personalise your profile.
Friends panel overhauled: Favourites / Online / Offline sections, ⭐ star to pin friends, portrait icons per row, and live status showing which channel each friend is in.
Friends online badge now shows accurate count regardless of which channel your friends are in.
Clan panel redesigned with rank groups (Chieftain / Shaman / Grunt / Peon), online-first sorting, and portrait icons.
Clan MOTD is now shown as a banner when joining a clan channel.
/ping now announces your latency publicly in the channel: 'Username ping: 33ms'.
Display name change (/name) now propagates live to all connected users without requiring a rejoin.
Screen share viewer can now click a View link in chat to request a screen share directly, without the sharer needing to manually add them.
DevTools shortcut (F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I) restored after menu removal broke it.

title: UI Polish & Command Improvements
items: Removed 'Chat Client' subtitle from the main app header — the banner now simply reads ElderKeep.
Removed 'Battle Chat' tagline from the login screen for a cleaner look.
Panel Font Size slider moved from Fonts tab to Layout tab — all size and width controls are now in one place.
Panel Font Size maximum raised from 18 px to 25 px.
Panel Width range extended: minimum 300 px, maximum 1000 px.
/ping command now shows your current latency directly in the chat log (visible only to you): [Your ping: 33ms].
/dnd now toggles Do Not Disturb on and off without any arguments — first use enables, second use disables.
Channel join is now case-insensitive: /j general and /j General both join the same channel.
Status Message field removed from Settings → Behavior (unused feature).
Voice Settings → Audio Devices section redesigned: clearer labels, expanded descriptions, and a note about granting microphone permission.

title: Screen Share Panel & PTT Fix
items: Screen sharing now opens in a dedicated window with a live preview of what you're sharing.
New per-user sharing controls: choose exactly who in your voice channel sees your screen — click Add or Remove next to each name.
Fixed screen sharing failing silently — ICE candidates were being dropped in a race condition on fast connections.
Fixed PTT key being stolen system-wide — any key set as PTT (Space, letters, F-keys, etc.) now still works normally in all other apps and text boxes.

title: Update Check Reliability
items: Sign In is now locked from the first frame of the login screen — no race window where fast users could click through before the update check starts.
Update check delay reduced from 5s to 500ms.

title: Drag-to-Resize Panel
items: Right panel can now be resized by dragging the left edge. Size syncs with the Settings slider and persists across sessions.

title: Auto-Updater & Client Polish
items: Auto-updater is now live — ElderKeep checks for updates on launch and downloads them silently in the background.
Login screen shows a live update status strip: Checking for updates → Downloading with % progress → Finishing up… → Restart & Install.
Sign In button is grayed out during the update check so you know it is in progress. It re-enables the moment the check completes.
'Finishing up…' spinner now appears when the download reaches 100% while the update is being unpacked and verified — no more frozen progress bar.
App version number is now displayed on the login screen.
Settings now correctly persist across logins — all toggles and sliders are restored exactly as you left them.
Panel Size slider now scales the Home, Profile, Settings, and Sign Out header buttons, the channel name, and the command bar buttons.
Removed the non-functional Interface Size slider from Settings.
Minimize to Tray option added in Settings → App Window — closing the window sends ElderKeep to the system tray instead of exiting.
App now appears as 'ElderKeep' with the correct icon in Task Manager instead of 'Electron'.
Fixed multiple Electron processes accumulating in Task Manager after repeated launches.
Fixed app lingering invisibly in Task Manager after closing — hidden overlay window is now properly destroyed on exit.
Patch notes on the home screen are now loaded live from GitHub — new notes appear for all users without requiring an app rebuild.

title: PTT Elevated App Support & Reliability
items: Push-to-Talk now works when apps running as Administrator (such as TeamSpeak) have focus. Run ElderKeep as Administrator to enable cross-app PTT against elevated processes.
PTT key setting now saves immediately when you press a new key — it no longer reverts to Space after restarting the app.
Fixed a bug where the PTT key would randomly change to a different key during use, causing the mic to stay on permanently.
Microphone no longer stays open after releasing the PTT key. A safety release is now sent whenever the PTT monitor restarts so the mic is never left stuck on.

Voice Settings now shows a real-time PTT hook status indicator: ⏳ initializing… while the hook is starting up, and ✔ ready when it is active. If ElderKeep is not running as Administrator a warning is shown so you know cross-app PTT will not work.
Log files are now written to a daily-rotating logs/ folder with clean local-time timestamps — one file per day, easy to find and share.

title: Global Push-to-Talk & More Bots
items: Push-to-Talk now works even when ElderKeep is not the focused window — you can be in a game or any other app and your PTT key will still activate your mic correctly.
The green speaking glow now lights up reliably whenever you press your PTT key, regardless of which window is in front.

Six additional WC3-themed bots join the server over time: Kel'Thuzad, Rexxar, Malfurion, Grom Hellscream, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Medivh — each with their own character-specific flavour lines. The bot roster now totals twelve.

title: Performance & Chat Bubbles
items: Chat Bubbles: a new overlay shows incoming messages in any corner of the screen — Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Left, or Bottom Right. Great for keeping an eye on chat while doing something else. Enable it in Settings → Behavior.
Regular chat, whispers, and emotes each appear with a distinct border colour so you can tell them apart at a glance. Your own messages never appear as bubbles.
Bubble settings: choose the corner, how long each bubble stays on screen (2–15 seconds), how many can stack at once, and the overall opacity.

Duck System Volume now works correctly — it lowers individual app entries in the Windows Volume Mixer instead of the master volume, so your voice stays at full volume while game audio and music are reduced. The previous implementation had a silent COM error that prevented it from working at all.
Voice chat now keeps working when ElderKeep is not the focused window, so you can be in a call while playing a game.

Major CPU reduction: the battlefield animation is capped at 30 fps, only one canvas draws at a time (login or app, not both), and the canvas pauses automatically when ElderKeep loses focus. A toggle in Settings → Appearance lets you keep it running if you prefer.

title: Voice Polish & Quality of Life
items: Duck System Volume: when you join a voice channel, ElderKeep can automatically lower your PC's master volume by a configurable amount so game audio or music doesn't drown out your friends. Volume is restored the moment you disconnect.
Noise gate: hard RMS cut below a configurable threshold — eliminates background hiss and keyboard noise without affecting your voice.
PTT release delay: keeps your mic open for a short tail after releasing Push-to-Talk so the last word of every sentence isn't clipped.
Hear Yourself: optionally route your own microphone back through your speakers for latency testing.
Audio bitrate selector: choose between Auto, 32 kbps, 64 kbps, 96 kbps, and 128 kbps to balance quality against bandwidth.
Join and leave sounds: a short WC3-style tone plays when users enter or leave your voice channel — each can be toggled independently.
Panel font size slider: a single slider in Settings scales the text in the Channel, Friends, Clan, and Voice panels simultaneously.
Speaking glow: your name and green dot now glow brightly when you talk — easier to tell at a glance who is speaking in a busy channel.
PTT speaking indicator fixed: the glow now activates correctly the moment you press your Push-to-Talk key.
Voice status moved into the Voice panel instead of a separate bar at the bottom of the screen — cleaner layout with mute, deafen, and disconnect always visible.
Clan rank management: Chieftains can now right-click any clan member to promote or demote them directly from the context menu.
Flood protection: five warnings before a 10-minute mute. Each warning applies a 1.5-second chat cooldown. Stop spamming and your warning count resets automatically.
Login screen fonts enlarged for better readability.

title: Private Calls, Clan Invites & Bots
items: Private voice calls: right-click any user and choose Voice Call to invite them into a dedicated private room. They receive an on-screen notification with a 30-second countdown to Accept or Decline.
Both participants are automatically joined into the same private voice room on Accept. Private calls appear under a separate "Private Calls" section in the Voice tab.
Clan officers (Chieftain or Shaman) can now invite clanless players via the command /c invite <name> or by right-clicking a username and choosing Clan Invite.
Six WC3-themed chat bots (Arthas, Thrall, Jaina, Illidan, Sylvanas, Uther) join channels and converse automatically — useful for testing a fresh server with no real users online.

title: Voice Chat Update
items: Full WebRTC voice chat is now live. Join any voice channel from the new Voice tab in the right panel — General, Gaming, and AFK are always available.
Real-time speaking indicators: a green pulse animates next to your name and the names of everyone talking in your channel.
Mute and Deafen buttons in the persistent voice status bar at the bottom of the screen. Deafen auto-mutes your microphone.
Voice Activation Detection (VAD) mode: your mic activates automatically when you speak above a configurable sensitivity threshold.
Push-to-Talk mode: hold any rebindable key to transmit. Works globally in the app without stealing focus from chat.
Per-user volume control: right-click any user in your voice channel to set their individual volume from 0 to 200%.
Full device management in Settings → Voice: select your microphone and speakers independently, with live device enumeration after permission is granted.
Input volume, output (master) volume, noise suppression, echo cancellation, and auto gain control toggles — all adjustable without rejoining.
Microphone test with a live level meter so you can confirm your mic is working before joining a call.
Automatic cleanup: disconnects gracefully on logout, app exit, and network drop.

title: UI & Channels Polish
items: Settings panel redesigned as a centered modal with tabs on the left and content on the right — more like a real application and less like a sidebar.
Added Town Square as a permanent public channel. Quick-join chips for Town Square, General, Random, and Off-Topic appear in the Channels modal.
Home button (⌂) in the header returns you to the news page from any channel.
Side panel width is now a single unified slider — Channel List, Friends List, and Clan List all scale together.
Removed /channels command to reduce chat clutter; use the Channels button on the home screen instead.
Fixed channel join input not responding to typing in Electron's sandboxed renderer — solved with double requestAnimationFrame focus timing.
News page font now respects the Chat Font Size slider in Settings so everything scales consistently.
Clan channels ([TAG] format) are now protected: no one can join a clan channel unless that clan actually exists.

title: Profile & Leveling Update
items: Added a full leveling system: earn XP for every minute active online. Level 1–255 with 15 WC3-themed rank titles from Peasant all the way to Warchief.
Profile pages with avatar, description, rank title, XP progress bar, time online, and clan affiliation.
Right-click any username in chat or the user list to view their profile, whisper, add as friend, and more.
Level badges now appear next to all usernames in the channel user list, color-coded by tier.
New News & Patch Notes landing page shown after login instead of auto-joining a channel.
Channels are now temporary — a user-created channel is removed automatically when the last person leaves.
Clan channels are auto-created when a clan is founded and persist until the clan is disbanded.
Login screen redesigned: transparent glass effect over the battlefield, modern line-style inputs, and a Remember Me option.

title: Battlefield & Commands Update
items: Completely replaced the background with a live WC3 Reign of Chaos battlefield: moon, fortress silhouette, dead trees, fire pits with embers, forked lightning, storm clouds, and rainfall.
Added a channel-change flash transition animation (under 2 seconds) for atmosphere.
All panels and the chat area are now fully transparent so the battlefield is always visible.
Implemented the full WC3 Battle.net command set: /w, /r, /who, /whois, /squelch, /away, /dnd, /kick, /ban, /unban, /op, /topic, /stats, /time, /ping, and more.
Friends subcommands: /friends add, remove, msg, list, promote, demote.
Clan subcommands: /c msg, list, plus direct chat fallback.

title: Foundation Release
items: Initial release of ElderKeep v2 — a Warcraft 3 Reign of Chaos inspired real-time chat client.
WebSocket chat with public channels, private whispers, emotes, and join/leave notifications.
Clan system with four ranks: Peon, Grunt, Shaman, and Chieftain. Includes invites, MOTD, and rank management.
Friends list with live online status tracking across channels.
Away and Do Not Disturb status modes.
Secure account registration and login with bcrypt password hashing and 7-day session tokens.
Persistent SQLite database via sql.js with automatic saving after every write.
